name: testsmt18.k
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (jupiter Ref)(europa Ref)(trip Ref)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((Body (mk-Body (mass Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((Planet (mk-Planet (mass Int)(distanceToEarth Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((Moon (mk-Moon (mass Int)(planet Ref)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((Trip (mk-Trip (missionStudy Ref)(firstStop Ref)(secondStop Ref)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-Body (sel-Body Body))
  (lift-Planet (sel-Planet Planet))
  (lift-Moon (sel-Moon Moon))
  (lift-Trip (sel-Trip Trip))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Body ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Body (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Body ((this Ref)) Body
  (sel-Body (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Planet ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Planet (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Planet ((this Ref)) Planet
  (sel-Planet (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Moon ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Moon (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Moon ((this Ref)) Moon
  (sel-Moon (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Trip ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Trip (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Trip ((this Ref)) Trip
  (sel-Trip (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Body ((this Ref)) Bool
  (or
    (deref-is-Body this)
    (deref-is-Planet this)
    (deref-is-Moon this)
  )
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Planet ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-Planet this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Moon ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-Moon this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Trip ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-Trip this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.jupiter: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!jupiter ((this Ref)) Ref
  (jupiter (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.europa: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!europa ((this Ref)) Ref
  (europa (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.trip: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!trip ((this Ref)) Ref
  (trip (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; ---------------------------
;   Getters for class Moon:
; ---------------------------

; --- getters for Moon.planet: ---

(define-fun Moon.planet ((this Ref)) Ref
  (planet (deref-Moon this))
)

(define-fun Moon!planet ((this Ref)) Ref
  (planet (deref-Moon this))
)

; ---------------------------
;   Getters for class Trip:
; ---------------------------

; --- getters for Trip.missionStudy: ---

(define-fun Trip!missionStudy ((this Ref)) Ref
  (missionStudy (deref-Trip this))
)

; --- getters for Trip.firstStop: ---

(define-fun Trip!firstStop ((this Ref)) Ref
  (firstStop (deref-Trip this))
)

; --- getters for Trip.secondStop: ---

(define-fun Trip!secondStop ((this Ref)) Ref
  (secondStop (deref-Trip this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Methods for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.getPlanet ((this Ref)(moon Ref)) Ref
  (Moon.planet moon)
)

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!getPlanet ((this Ref)(moon Ref)) Ref
  (Moon.planet moon)
)

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (deref (TopLevelDeclarations!jupiter this)) (lift-Planet (mk-Planet 50000 588000000)))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert0))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (deref (TopLevelDeclarations!europa this)) (lift-Moon (mk-Moon 1 (TopLevelDeclarations!jupiter this))))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv2 0) :named _xkassert1))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-Planet (TopLevelDeclarations!jupiter this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv3 0) :named _xkassert2))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-Moon (TopLevelDeclarations!europa this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv4 0) :named _xkassert3))

; --- Invariant 5: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv5 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-Trip (TopLevelDeclarations!trip this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv5 0) :named _xkassert4))



; -----------------------------
;   Invariant for class Body:
; -----------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-2-Body Body)
(declare-const const-3-Body Body)
(declare-const const-4-Body Body)



; -------------------------------
;   Invariant for class Planet:
; -------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-5-Planet Planet)
(declare-const const-6-Planet Planet)



; -----------------------------
;   Invariant for class Moon:
; -----------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-Moon Moon)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun Moon.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-Planet (Moon!planet this))
)

(assert (! (Moon.inv1 1) :named _xkassert5))



; -----------------------------
;   Invariant for class Trip:
; -----------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-7-Trip Trip)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun Trip.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (Trip!firstStop this) (TopLevelDeclarations!europa 0))
)

(assert (! (Trip.inv1 7) :named _xkassert6))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun Trip.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (Trip!secondStop this) (TopLevelDeclarations!getPlanet 0 (Trip!firstStop this)))
)

(assert (! (Trip.inv2 7) :named _xkassert7))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun Trip.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-Body (Trip!missionStudy this))
)

(assert (! (Trip.inv3 7) :named _xkassert8))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun Trip.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-Body (Trip!firstStop this))
)

(assert (! (Trip.inv4 7) :named _xkassert9))

; --- Invariant 5: ---

(define-fun Trip.inv5 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-Body (Trip!secondStop this))
)

(assert (! (Trip.inv5 7) :named _xkassert10))

; --- Invariant 6: ---

(define-fun Trip.inv6 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (Trip!missionStudy this) (TopLevelDeclarations!europa 0))
)

(assert (! (Trip.inv6 7) :named _xkassert11))




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store(store(store(store(store(store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        2 (lift-Body const-2-Body))
        3 (lift-Body const-3-Body))
        4 (lift-Body const-4-Body))
        5 (lift-Planet const-5-Planet))
        6 (lift-Planet const-6-Planet))
        1 (lift-Moon const-1-Moon))
        7 (lift-Trip const-7-Trip))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun const-4-Body () Body
  (mk-Body 10))
(define-fun const-2-Body () Body
  (mk-Body 12))
(define-fun const-7-Trip () Trip
  (mk-Trip 1 1 5))
(define-fun const-1-Moon () Moon
  (mk-Moon 1 5))
(define-fun const-3-Body () Body
  (mk-Body 11))
(define-fun const-0-TopLevelDeclarations () TopLevelDeclarations
  (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 5 1 7))
(define-fun const-5-Planet () Planet
  (mk-Planet 50000 588000000))
(define-fun const-6-Planet () Planet
  (mk-Planet 8 9))
(define-fun _xkassert6 () Bool
  (= (firstStop (sel-Trip (select heap 7)))
   (europa (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0)))))
(define-fun _xkassert7 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (firstStop (sel-Trip (select heap 7))))))
  (= (secondStop (sel-Trip (select heap 7))) (planet (sel-Moon a!1)))))
(define-fun _xkassert2 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (jupiter (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-Planet a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert5 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (planet (sel-Moon (select heap 1))))))
  (is-lift-Planet a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert9 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (firstStop (sel-Trip (select heap 7))))))
  (or (is-lift-Body a!1) (is-lift-Planet a!1) (is-lift-Moon a!1))))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (jupiter (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (= a!1 (lift-Planet (mk-Planet 50000 588000000)))))
(define-fun _xkassert8 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (missionStudy (sel-Trip (select heap 7))))))
  (or (is-lift-Body a!1) (is-lift-Planet a!1) (is-lift-Moon a!1))))
(define-fun _xkassert10 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (secondStop (sel-Trip (select heap 7))))))
  (or (is-lift-Body a!1) (is-lift-Planet a!1) (is-lift-Moon a!1))))
(define-fun _xkassert3 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (europa (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-Moon a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert11 () Bool
  (= (missionStudy (sel-Trip (select heap 7)))
   (europa (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0)))))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (europa (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0)))))
      (a!2 (mk-Moon 1 (jupiter (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (= a!1 (lift-Moon a!2))))
(define-fun _xkassert4 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (trip (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-Trip a!1)))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun k!heap_full!Moon () Bool
  true)
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (let ((a!1 (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
                         0
                         (lift-TopLevelDeclarations
                           (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 5 1 7)))
                  2
                  (lift-Body (mk-Body 12)))))
(let ((a!2 (store (store a!1 3 (lift-Body (mk-Body 11)))
                  4
                  (lift-Body (mk-Body 10)))))
(let ((a!3 (store (store a!2 5 (lift-Planet (mk-Planet 50000 588000000)))
                  6
                  (lift-Planet (mk-Planet 8 9)))))
  (store (store a!3 1 (lift-Moon (mk-Moon 1 5))) 7 (lift-Trip (mk-Trip 1 1 5)))))))
(define-fun k!heap_full!Planet () Bool
  true)
(define-fun k!heap_full!Body () Bool
  true)
(define-fun k!heap_full!Trip () Bool
  true)
